Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that's all we have from this outstanding match. This series is off to a great start. The second ODI is on Friday, 25th February 2022, at 10.30 am IST (5 am GMT). Do join us in advance for all the action. Cheers!

Tamim Iqbal, the winning skipper of Bangladesh, is very proud at the moment. He starts by admitting that he had no belief that they will win this match. Adds that he is very happy with the way those youngsters batted. Tells that Afghanistan have a great bowling attack and the way Afif and Mehidy handled them was amazing. Hopes that they continue to do that in future as well.
Mehidy Hasan is given the Player of the Match award! He was exceptional with the ball and then was involved in a record partnership with Afif Hossain.

Hashmatullah Shahidi, the captain of Afghanistan, says that they had a good start with the ball but after that Bangladesh's batters played really well and didn't give any chance to them. Adds that they were at least 30 runs short. Mentions that they started well but wants to credit the batsmen of Bangladesh. Tells that it's part and parcel of the game and they will try to come out strongly in the next match.

Afghanistan will be shell-shocked at the moment. They were below-par with the bat and managed just 215 runs but then their bowlers gave them a real chance. Fazalhaq Farooqi showed his class with the new ball and had the hosts on the mat. The Afghans though failed to capitalize on the start. Once the pair of Afif Hossain and Mehidy Hasan settled in, there wasn't much pressure applied on them. The asking rate was never too demanding and Afghanistan needed more intensity in the field. Also, Hashmatullah Shahidi was very late in bringing Fazalhaq Farooqi for his second spell and there the touring team perhaps missed a trick. They now have suffered their first loss in the ICC World Cup Super League 2020–2022 but still have 20 points to play for in the series.

It was a shocking start for Bangladesh in the chase! There were blown away by Fazalhaq Farooqi who picked four wickets in his first three overs and ran amok. By the 12th over, the writing was on the wall for Bangladesh as they were reduced to 45 for 6. After the batting crumbled like cookies, two calm headed lads joined forces. As the saying goes, when the going gets tough, the tough gets going. The pair of Afif Hossain and Mehidy Hasan not only soaked up the pressure of imminent defeat but also went on to script an unbelievable win for Bangladesh. Their record unbeaten alliance of 174 runs stole all the momentum away from Afghanistan and eventually, it turned out to be an easy win for the home team.

A resounding fightback from Bangladesh! A hard-fought win but it will give them a lot of happiness and belief. Their backs were to the wall and if you had stopped following this match after the 12th over, you have missed a sensational partnership and will be in for a big surprise. Take a bow, Afif. Take a bow, Mehidy! The crowd is going mad, the Bangladesh dugout is ecstatic. A standing ovation from the VIP box.

FOUR! Here are the winning runs! Afif Hossain ends things in style for his side. A short ball, on off, Afif Hossain powers it over mid-wicket for a boundary. Afif Hossain thanks the heavens and ends his innings on 93 runs. What a day for this young man! BANGLADESH WIN THE GAME BY 4 WICKETS.
A slower delivery, full, on middle, Hossain defends it to the leg side with soft hands.
SCORES LEVEL! Back of a length, outside off. Afif Hossain hangs back and slams it over point for a brace.
On a length, around middle, Mehidy stays back and helps it towards mid on for a single. 3 more needed.
Full in length and outside off, Mehidy pushes it with an angled bat to short third man. Looks for a run but is sent back.
Back of a length, on off. Hossain comes down the track and looks to finish the game off in style with a pull shot but gets a bottom edge towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Afif Hossain looks to be in a hurry. A length ball, on the pads. Hossain stays back and whips it to fine leg for a boundary. This is some incredible batting.

This is excellent running! What a show by this young pair. The crowd is cheering every single run. A length ball, outside off. Hasan drives it through covers. The fielder takes time to get to the ball and the batters run three.
Fazalhaq Farooqi comes in from 'round the wicket and serves a length ball, on off. Hasan stands back and blocks it out solidly.
Swing and a miss! A length ball, outside off. Hasan tries to reach out but fails to get any bat on it.
FOUR! CRUNCHED! Back of a length, outside off. Hasan stands tall and punches it through point for a boundary. There is no chance for any fielder to get to it.

Touch short and outside off. Afif Hossain plays it late towards third man. Straight to the fielder. The pair has done really well to see off Rashid Khan's spell here. Bangladesh now need 15 runs off 3 overs.
Tossed up, full and on the pads. Hasan flicks it to the leg side for a single.
Floated, on leg, Hasan plays it back to the bowler.
Flatter and on the stumps. Hasan goes back and punches it to covers.
The physio comes out! Rashid Khan seems to have hurt his hamstring.
Fuller and around off, Mehidy drives it to the left of the bowler who stretches in that direction to make the stop. Seems to have done some damage in the process.
Fuller and on middle, defended back.
Short and on middle, pulled to deep square leg for a single.
Short and around off, Afif mistimes his pull shot in the air. The ball drops safely at square leg and they cross.

NOT OUT! Afghanistan lose their second review and now they have nothing left in the bank. A length ball, angled down leg. Hossain looks to heave it across the line but misses. The umpire signals a wide initially while Fazalhaq Farooqi appeals for caught behind. The Afghan keeper convinces his skipper to take it upstairs and Hashmatullah Shahidi signals the 'T'. The UltraEdge shows no bat is involved and it went off the pads. The onfield decision of NOT OUT stays and the wide is cancelled.

A review for caught behind. No one seems interested apart from Rahmanullah Gurbaz, the wicketkeeper. No bat, confirms the UltraEdge. The wide that was signalled is taken back by the onfield umpire as there was a slight contact with the thigh pad.

FOUR! Nicely played. Afif Hossain moves into his 80s. A length ball, just outside off. Afif Hossain plays it late and guides it down to third with a deft touch for a boundary. The young man is taking his side closer to the finish line.
WIDE! Full length, sliding down leg. Afif Hossain tries to flick it away but misses. Wide called.
Full length, on the pads. Afif Hossain stands back and flicks it aerially over mid-wicket. Mohammad Nabi races to his left from long on to keep it down to two runs.
FOUR! Up and over! What a shot! A full-length ball, outside off. Afif Hossain gets under it and lofts it over mid off to bag a boundary.
Quicker through the air, full and flat around off, it's defended safely to the off side. Mujeeb is done with his 10 overs. 29 needed off the last 5 overs.
Full and floated outside off, Mehidy lunges and defends it back.
Serves it short and outside off, Afif goes back and cuts it through point for one.
Loopy and full around middle, Mehidy tucks it to short fine leg for a brisk single.
Flatter one, around off, defended off the back foot.
Loopy and full around off, Mehidy defends it back to the bowler.
On a length around off, Afif helps it with gentle hands to mid-wicket. 7 from the over, 31 needed more off 36 balls.
FOUR! Clobbered! Fazalhaq Farooqi tries to nail another yorker but this time it turns out to be a full toss. Afif smacks it over the bowler's head for a cracking boundary.
Fazalhaq Farooqi nails his yorker on off, Afif brings his bat down in time to dig it out.
Very full and on off, Mehidy digs it out to mid off and races away to the other end.
Serves it on a good length, around off and angling in, Afif plays late and taps it down to covers for one.
Slower one, wide outside off, it's forced square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Change. Fazalhaq Farooqi is back into the attack now.

FOUR! Important boundary for Bangladesh! Rashid Khan drags his length short and delivers it around off, Afif Hossain immediately rocks back and hammers it to wide long on. The fielder in the deep rushes across to his left, puts in a slide but fails to keep it in. 38 needed off 42 balls.
Flatter and on off, Afif plays late and taps it down to short third man again.
Fuller and close to off, Afif plays late and guides it to short third man.
Short and outside off, turning away, Mehidy goes back to cut and places it towards short third man. Mujeeb Ur Rahman misfields and makes the single easy.
Fullish and close to off, eased towards cover-point for a brisk single.
Flatter through the air, short and around off, Afif goes back to cut but gets an inside edge.
Fires it in, full and around middle, Afif wrists it towards mid-wicket and scampers across to the other end. 44 needed off 48 balls now.
Full and flighted, landing around middle, Afif presses forward and defends it to the off side.
Short and on off, Mehidy goes on the back foot and strokes it to sweeper cover for a single.
Flatter off spinner, around off, defended to the off side.
Allows the ball to spin back in and then taps it down to point. Dot again.
Floated and full around off, Mehidy defends it back to the bowler.
Flatter and shorter, on the pads, it's nudged behind square leg for a single. 46 needed more off 54 balls.
Fullish and around off, from 'round the wicket, Afif closes the face of his bat and works it towards square leg for one.
Quicker and fuller on middle, helped away to mid-wicket.
Loopy and full, around off, Hossain tries to drive but it takes the inner edge and rolls back to the bowler.
Drags his length short, outside off, Afif cracks it off his back foot but fails to beat the diving cover fielder.
Full and flighted, on the pads, Mehidy helps it in front of square leg for a single.
Powerplay 3 time. One extra fielder, i.e. 5 can now be put outside the 30-yard circle till the end of this chase. Rashid Khan is back on.
Fuller, outside off. Hasan shuffles across and drives it down the ground for an easy single. Under 50 needed now.
Flatter and on off. Hasan taps it to point.
Short and outside off, cut through cover-point for a run.
Angled in full, on middle and leg. Hossain remains solid in his defense.
Full and on off. Hossain stays back and blocks it out solidly.
Angled in, full and on leg. Hossain defends it back to the bowler.
FOUR! What a shot! Bangladesh inching closer to the finish line now. Short ball, outside off. Hasan hangs back and steers it down to third man for a boundary.
Floated, full and on off. Hasan drives it to covers but not in the gap.
Full and outside off, Hasan leans in and defends it to covers.
Full and on the stumps. Hasan defends it out.
The batter has just watchfully blocked this out.
Fuller and on off, Mehidy goes to defend but it takes the outside edge and rolls to short third man.
Floated and on off. Hasan pushes it to the off side for a single.
Tossed up, full and on off. Hasan clips it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Edgy! Short in length and outside off, Mehidy Hasan goes back to cut but it takes the outside edge and races wide of short third man for a boundary.
Full and on leg. Hasan leans in and tucks it to square leg. Not in the gap again.
On middle and leg. Hasan nudges it to the leg side but fails to beat the diving square leg fielder.
Quicker and flatter, on off, Hasan blocks it back to the bowler.
Mohammad Nabi is back on. 0/23 in his 7 overs so far.
Fuller, on the pads. Hasan clips it to deep square leg for another single. Only two runs off it.
Fuller in length, around leg, knocked down to long on for a single.
Full, on middle and leg. Hossain nudges it to mid-wicket.
Floated, full and on off. Hossain blocks it out watchfully.
Fuller, on the stumps, Hossain defends it out solidly.
Touch short and on off. Hossain guides it to backward point.
Afghanistan are forced to think here! A conflab going on, involving Hashmatullah Shahidi and a few senior players. Mujeeb Ur Rahman has been brought back into the attack.
FOUR! WHAT A KNOCK BY HASAN! He gets his second FIFTY in the ODI format. Back of a length, on off. Hasan rides the bounce and pulls it through square leg for a boundary. 62 needed more.
Full length, on the stumps. Hasan gets his blade down and defends it to the off side.
A length ball, on off. Hasan defends it out solidly. This is really good batting. Not getting carried away after hitting a boundary.

FOUR! With this boundary, this now becomes the highest seventh-wicket stand for Bangladesh in ODIs. It is a short ball, on off, Hasan stands tall and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary. He gets it into the gap and into the fence. Mehidy Hasan moves to 49!
A good-length ball, outside off. Hasan hangs back and looks to chase it but misses.
Good length, outside off, shaping away. Afif Hossain stands tall and cuts it through point for a single.
Fuller and around off, Mehidy pushes it off his front foot to covers.

FOUR! Through the legs of the keeper! Flighted and outside off, Mehidy Hasan goes down for the sweep shot but under-edges it through the legs of Rahmanullah Gurbaz for a boundary behind. First boundary for the hosts after the 28th over. The century stand comes up, 71 needed more off 91 balls.
This one hurried onto the batsman from a shorter length around off, Afif plays well and keeps it out through cover-point for one.
Short and on off, Mehidy goes back and plays it down to backward point for a brisk run. Mujeeb scores a direct hit at the keeper's end but Afif Hossain is safely in.
Loopy delivery, full and around off, a real tempter from Nabi, Afif strokes it to long off for a single.
Very full and around off, angling in, it's pushed defensively to covers.
Mohammad Nabi (6-1-16-0) is back into the attack now.
Fuller and around off, Mehidy drives it back to the bowler. Fazalhaq Farooqi, minus his black headband, has not looked threatening in the second spell.
Digs it in short, around off, Mehidy gets on top of the bounce and jams it down on the surface.
Back of a length around off, Afif plays late and guides it to third man for a run.
Darts it full and close to off, angling in, Afif defends it down to mid on.
A touch short and around off, Mehidy gets across and drops it with gentle hands in front of square leg for a single.
Short and around middle, Afif pulls it behind square leg and picks up a single.
Tossed up, full and around off, it's blocked off the front foot. Maiden from Rashid! 81 needed off 102 balls.

Appeal for a caught behind, the finger has stayed down though! Full and floated outside off, turning away, Mehidy tries to smash it over covers but misses. The keeper collects the ball, they appeal but to no avail. Afghanistan have not taken the referral. The replays, later on, show that there was no spike off the bat and it was the blade hitting the floor.
Loopy and around off, Mehidy defends it ahead of his front pad.
Flatter and on middle, Mehidy goes on the back foot in defense.
Tossed up, around off, defended back to the bowler.
Floated and full around leg, Mehidy clips it off his pads to short fine leg.
A touch short and close to off, Afif hangs on the back foot and pushes it with an angled bat to point.
A low full toss, around off, Afif strokes it to mid off and this time decides to take no chance against Rashid Khan. Dot.

Appeal for an lbw, turned down! Fuller in length, around middle and leg, from 'round the wicket, Mehidy tries to flick but misses. It goes off his pads to square leg and they cross. Afghanistan decide not to review it and now the signal for a leg bye comes.

The physio comes out to have a look at Afif Hossain. He looks to be in some pain after the dive. The magic spray is out now. Afif Hossain might need some time to settle down before he can get back in the crease. The physio shows the thumbs up to the player and we are back underway.

Risky single! Fuller in length and outside off, Afif pushes it towards mid off and scoots to the other end. Rashid attacks the ball, has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. That would have been curtains for Afif. Even his full-length dive would not have saved him. He seems to have hurt his shoulder in the process.
Swing and a miss! Fazalhaq Farooqi bends his back to go short, it's around off and shooting up, Afif tries to pull but fails to connect.
Back of a length, around off, Afif stays back and taps it down to point. The fielder collects the ball and knocks down the stumps at the bowler's end but Mehidy is safely in.
Fazalhaq Farooqi (5-1-19-4) is back into the attack now.
Short and wide, cut to covers where the fielder fumbles and allowed a run. 83 needed off 114 balls.
Slower through the air, short and around off, turning in, Afif punches but finds the cover fielder.
Loopy and full, around off, it's defended watchfully off the front foot.
Quicker and flatter, around middle, Mehidy gets back and works it behind square leg for one.

FIFTY FOR AFIF! The crowd cheers! A gem of a knock so far from the young man but he needs to carry on. Short and wide outside off, Hossain goes on the back foot and cuts it through point for a single.
Full and flighted, around off, Afif is on the front foot as he defends it to the off side.
A long break, this. Still waiting for the artificial lights to take full control. Now, we are ready to resume! Here is Rashid Khan...

Rashid Khan is back for another spell with Afghanistan in need of a wicket now. 1 for 17 in Rashid's 5 overs so far. Hang on, there seems to be some issue with the artificial lights. The umpires have decided to take Drinks. Bangladesh have recovered well through the stand between Mehidy Hasan and Afif Hossain. They are in a much better position now and have a glimmer of hope. Afghanistan would believe that it's just a matter of one wicket and they will be into the Bangla tail. It's tightly poised.
A single now! This stand is growing really well. Full and outside off. Hossain defends it to the off side for a single. 86 runs needed in 120 balls.
Tossed up, full and close to off. Hossain opens the face of the bat late and guides it down to third man for a brace.
Full, on off, defended out solidly.
Fuller and outside off. Hossain presses forward and defends it to the off side.
Floated, full and on off, Hossain defends it back to the bowler.
Slower through the air, full and on off. Hasan taps it to point for one.
Fuller and around middle, Afif flicks but finds the mid-wicket fielder. 90 needed more off 126 balls.
Quicker and shorter on off, cut to deep point for just a run.
Short in length and outside off, Mehidy goes on the back foot and cuts it through backward point for a couple.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Hasan stays back and flicks it to mid-wicket. Not in the gap though.
Touch short, outside off. Hossain cuts it to deep cover for a single.
Full and on the stumps. Hasan paddles it to fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Deft touch! Afif Hossain playing with the field now. Touch short and on off. Hossain plays it late and steers it down to third man for a boundary. The ball evades the slip fielder with ease.
Quicker, full and angling down leg. Afif Hossain fails to pick it off his pads. He gets rapped on the pads, Mujeeb Ur Rahman appeals but the umpire is unmoved.
What a delivery! Looped up, outside off. It skids back in a long way. Afif Hossain goes back and looks to cut it away but get it out off the top half of the blade. This was very close.
A low full toss on middle, it's driven to long on for a single.
Flatter and on the stumps. Hasan stays inside the crease and defends it out.
Fuller, on off. Hasan stays back and blocks it to covers.
Change in bowling. Mujeeb Ur Rahman is back into the attack. 1/15 in his 5 overs so far.
A maiden for Nabi. Fuller and on off, Hossain defends it out off the front foot.
Tossed up, full, outside off. Afif Hossain defends it out solidly. Five dots in a row!
Looped up, full and on off. Afif Hossain prods and blocks it out.
Three dots in a row! Full and on off. Hossain continues to remain solid in his defense.
Floated, full and outside off. Hossain drives it to point with soft hands.
Tossed up, on off. Hossain gets forward and defends it from the inner portion of his bat.

FOUR! Mehidy Hasan puts away a loose delivery. Short in length, wide outside off. Mehidy Hasan stays back and slashes it through point, all along the ground, for a boundary. 100 needed more as the crowd roars!
A length ball, on the fourth stump line. Hasan shuffles across and blocks it out solidly.
Full length, outside off. Hasan blocks it out to the off side.

EDGY! Afif Hossain has some lady luck by his side. Full length, on off. Afif Hossain is a tad early in his attempt to flick it to the leg side. The ball takes the leading edge and lobs over the infield at covers. They take one.
Full length, outside off. Afif Hossain leans in and drives it to covers.
FOUR! In the air, in the gap and a boundary. A full-length ball, on the pads. Hossain flicks it aerially towards deep square leg and bisects the fielders in the deep for a boundary.
Shorter in length, outside off, Hasan goes back to cut but misses. Four tidy overs from Nabi so far.
Tossed up, landing full around leg, Mehidy flicks but finds square leg.
Fuller and outside off, pushed to covers.
Turning in from outside off, no pace there, Hasan gets back to play late but fails to time it properly.
Shortish and on off, Afif goes back and punches it to deep cover for a single.

Mishit...'catch it' is the shout but it falls safely. Floated and full, around off, Mehidy advances down the track for a big shot over the bowler's head but drags it off the inner half. It goes on one bounce to long on and they cross.
Again it's short and wide outside off, Mehidy cuts it towards point where the fielder fumbles and deflects it behind. They cross for a single. 111 needed more.
Short in length and outside off, slower in pace, Mehidy chops his attempted square and it goes on one bounce to point.
Back of a length, on off, Mehidy goes on the back foot and pushes it to covers.
Edgy! Fuller and closer to off, Afif is forward with a straight bat but it takes the outside edge and speeds down to third man for a single.
Width again outside off, short in length, Mehidy stands back and slaps it to deep cover for a single.
Flashes and misses! Short in length and outside off, shaping away, Mehidy throws his bat at it but fails to connect.
Too full and on middle, Hasan forces it down to long on and picks up a single.
Identical to the last delivery, Hasan plays with the spin again and gently defends it to short mid-wicket.
Tossed up and around off, Mehidy leans forward and defends it to short mid-wicket.
Fuller and close to off, Mehidy drives it back and the bowler collects it to his right.
Quicker and on off, defended off the back foot.
Loopy and full around off, Mehidy defends it off the leading half to covers.

FOUR! Smashed away! Short in length and wide outside off, at 128 clicks, Afif Hossain camps on the back foot and blazes it through point for a boundary. 100 comes up for Bangladesh. They are making a steady recovery after early hiccups.
Wide! Down the leg side, fuller in length, Afif fails to get any wood behind it.
Angles it in, on a length around off, Afif is forward as he pushes it with an angled bat to cover-point.
Beats the outside edge by a whisker! Gulbadin Naib speeds in from 'round the wicket and delivers it short outside off, Afif tries to cut but it bounces extra and flies over his blade.
Back of a length around leg, Mehidy drags his attempted pull shot down to fine leg and runs the first run hard. That's all he will get.
Width outside off, short in length, this time Mehidy goes chasing after it and misses.
Starts his spell by serving a length ball in the region outside off, Mehidy has nothing to do with it.
Gulbadin Naib comes into the attack now.
Fullish and on off, knocked down to long on for one. The 50-run stand has come up! These two are trying their best to revive the chase. 121 needed off 174 balls.
A slider on off, fuller in length, Afif tries to defend but it takes an inside edge and rolls to square leg. They cross for a single.
Flighted and full around off, Mehidy drops it with soft hands to the right of backward point and steals a single.
Played late! Spinning in from outside off, Mehidy goes back and dabs it past short third man for a couple of runs.
Around the pads, clipped behind square leg for one.
Flighted and on middle, defended on the leg side.

Flatter and on off. Hasan blocks it back to the bowler. Rashid Khan gathers the ball and throws the ball towards the keeper. But ends up hitting Hasan on the shoulders. Rashid Khan gets up and goes to have a check on the batter as his intentions were not to hit him.
BEATEN! What a beauty! Slower one, flighted, full and outside off, Mehidy Hasan prods forward and looks to defend it out but misses. The ball turns away off the deck to beat the outside edge.
Full and outside off. Hasan defends it out solidly.
Very full and around off, Afif drives it past the diving extra cover fielder for a single.
Loopy and full, around middle, Mehidy tickles it to square leg and crosses for a single.
Fuller and flatter on off, Mehidy defends it off his front foot.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Hossain clips it to mid-wicket.
Short and outside off. Hossain cuts it square on the off side but finds point.
Full and on off, blocked out.
Tossed up, full and on off, Hossain blocks it out solidly.
Full and on off. Hasan works it down the ground for a single at long on.
Slower through the air, full and wide outside off, Afif drives it through covers and takes a single.
Spin from both ends now. Mohammad Nabi to roll his arm...
Around off, Hossain punches it towards covers for a single.
Full and outside off. Hossain leans in and blocks it out.
Quicker, fuller on the stumps. Hasan defends it back to the bowler.
Darted on the pads. Hossain clips it to the leg side for one.
Tossed up, full and on middle. Hasan works it towards mid on for a single.
Fuller and on the stumps. Hasan defends it out.
SIX! BANG! Afif Hossain on the charge. Back of a length, outside off. Afif Hossain stands tall and pulls it over square leg fence for a biggie.
Full length, on the pads. Hasan clips it to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Second boundary of the over. Mehidy Hasan making sure to punish all the loose balls. Back of a length, outside off. Mehidy Hasan stands tall and cuts it through point for a boundary.
A sharp bumper, on leg. Mehidy Hasan ducks under it and leaves it alone.
FOUR! Top shot! A length ball, on the fourth stump line. Mehidy Hasan stands tall and punches it through backward point for a boundary.
Length ball, on off, Hasan defends it out solidly.
FOUR! A much-needed boundary. Afif Hossain showing good resistance. Fuller and wide outside off. Afif Hossain reaches out and slashes it just over the leaping cover fielder for a boundary.
Quicker, full, on leg. Hossain fails to flick it away and gets hit on the pads. Rashid Khan makes a half appeal and the umpire shakes his head.
An easy single as this is pushed down to long on.
Floated, full and on the pads. Mehidy Hasan clips it to the leg side.
Fuller and on off. Mehidy Hasan defends it out.
Flatter and on the stumps. Afif Hossain chips it past the bowler towards mid on for a single.
Another single. Afif forces it towards mid off and scampers across to the other end.
Short and wide outside off, Mehidy stands back and slaps it to deep point for one.
Around middle, on a length, Mehidy helps it in front of square leg where the fielder dives across to his right to stop the ball.
Width outside off, short in length, Afif whacks it to deep point and rotates the strike.
Slightly short and around off, Mehidy Hasan goes on the back foot and punches it square of the wicket on the off side. Beats point and picks up a single.
Serves it on a length around off, shaping in, Mehidy defends it from the back foot.

Drinks break! The hosts are in all sorts of trouble. They are running short on wickets at the moment with only 4 left in the bank. The target was not a big one but the Afghanistan bowlers have made sure to turn it into a mountain. They are dictating terms at the moment and would be surely eyeing their 7th ODI win on the trot. Can the Afghan bowlers bundle out Bangladesh below 100?
Floated and around leg, Afif leans and defends it on the leg side.
Short and around off, Afif gets back and slaps it through cover-point for a brace.
Fuller and on middle, worked away on the leg side but not in the gap.
Slower through the air, on middle, Afif tries to flick but closes the face of his bat early. It lobs in the air off the leading edge but dies down quickly in the middle of the pitch.
Flatter and a touch shorter on off, punched down to long off for a single.
Beaten! Superb delivery. A quicker one, landing full around off and turning away a hint, Mehidy tries to defend inside the line and gets beaten.
Fuller and around off, from 'round the wicket, Afif checks his drive and pushes it to short cover.
On a length outside off, angling away, Afif stays on the back foot and taps it down to point.
Fullish and outside off, Mehidy drives it through covers for a single.
That's loose. Short in length and wide outside off, Mehidy throws his bat at it but fails to connect.
A touch short and on off, Hasan stays on the back foot and plays it down to point.
Lands it on a length around off, Afif stays back to defend it down on the off side and they cross for a quick run.
Gets back and works it in front of square leg for a single.
Flatter and on off, defended off the back foot.

SAFE! Rashid delivers a googly around leg, Afif gets across the stumps a bit as he attempts to work it away off his pads. He seems to have missed the ball and is rapped on the pads. It races away to the fine leg fence. The appeal is made, it's turned down and Shahidi opts for the DRS. The Ball Tracking shows that it's pitching outside the leg stump. FOUR LEG BYES and Bangladesh bring up their 50.

Review! Afghanistan take a review for lbw. The onfield decision is NOT OUT. The third umpire confirms it is a fair delivery. The UltraEdge later show no bat is involved. The Ball Tracking shows it is pitching outside the line and Afghanistan lose a review this time. Afif Hossain still at the crease.
Loopy and full outside off, Mehidy drives it through covers for a single.
Mehidy Hasan comes in at number 8.

OUT! CAUGHT! Rashid Khan does what he does best! A flat delivery, on the shorter side outside off and it spins away at 94.3 kph. Mahmudullah goes deep inside the crease and tries to force it through the off side. But the ball turns to take the outside edge and travels at the rate of knots to first slip. Gulbadin Naib is alert and snaps a fantastic catch. Six wickets down and Bangladesh are inching closer to an embarrassing defeat.
Commentary.Howout: c Gulbadin Naib b Rashid Khan

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter and shorter outside off, a leg break, Mahmudullah cuts it softly to point.
Close to off, on a length and angling away, Afif remains on the back foot and defends it to point.
Rashid Khan comes into the attack now. He replaces Mujeeb Ur Rahman.
Wide! That's not the line. Way down the leg side, Afif leaves and Rahmanullah Gurbaz dives across to his right to collect the ball.
Full and angling down the leg side again, Mahmudullah fails to flick and it goes off his pads to square leg. They cross for a leg bye.
Angling down the leg side, Mahmudullah tries to flick but misses. It clips his pads and goes to the keeper.
Fuller and angling in around off, at 139.5 kph, Mahmudullah gets forward and pushes it to cover-point.
Lands it on a length and around off, Mahmudullah defends it off his back foot to covers.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Yamin Ahmadzai begins with a gentle loosener, it's on a length and on the pads, Mahmudullah eases it away off his pads and finds the fence at fine leg.
Powerplay 2 time. A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the ring till the 40th over. Yamin Ahmadzai replaces Fazalhaq Farooqi from this end.
Full and outside off. Afif Hossain presses forward and defends it out solidly.

FOUR! Nicely played by Afif Hossain this time. It is quicker, full and angled down leg, Afif Hossain shuffles across a bit and uses the pace of the ball wisely to send it racing away to the fine leg boundary.
Wide outside off, Afif Hossain leaves it alone for the keeper.
Fuller and outside off. Afif Hossain drives it through covers for a brace now.
Tossed up, on middle and leg. Afif Hossain nudges it to the leg side.
Full, on middle, Afif Hossain flicks it to mid-wicket.

Fuller in length, wide outside off, but just inside the tramline. Mahmudullah lets it sail past him and into the keeper's mitts. 5 runs off the over. Fazalhaq Farooqi did not trouble the batters much in this over.
A short ball, around the hips. Mahmudullah hops inside the crease and flicks it towards fine leg. Mujeeb Ur Rahman runs to his right and puts in a dive to that side to save a boundary. Two taken.
Back of a length, around the hips. Afif Hossain pulls it to deep square leg for one. Fazalhaq Farooqi now gets the right-hander back on strike.
A length ball, on off. Mahmudullah steers it down to third man for a single.
WIDE! Fazalhaq Farooqi bangs in a short ball but down the leg side. The umpire signals a wide.
Back of a length, close to the batter this time, outside off. It nips away a touch. Mahmudullah leaves it alone yet again.
A full-length ball, outside off, shaping across the right-hander. Mahmudullah leaves it alone for the keeper.
Fuller and on leg. Afif Hossain defends it to mid-wicket. An outstanding over by Mujeeb Ur Rahman comes to an end. Two runs and a wicket off it.
Angled in with the arm, full, on middle and off. Afif Hossain gets his blade down in time to block it out.
Afif Hossain is the new batter.

OUT! DRAGGED ON! Afghanistan are all over Bangladesh at the moment as half of the side has been sent back to the pavilion. Mujeeb Ur Rahman gets his first wicket of the innings. He is elated. A carrom ball is delivered wide outside off, Shakib Al Hasan looks to chase it but only manages to get an inside edge and the ball goes onto rattle the stumps. Shakib Al Hasan trudges back as well.
Short and on the pads. Mahmudullah flicks it through square leg for a run.
Fuller, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan drives it to covers on the up. They take a single.
Floated, full and on off. Shakib Al Hasan pushes it back to the bowler.
A dot to end the over! Good length, outside off, shaping across the right-hander. Mahmudullah stays back and shoulders arm to it. 5 runs off the over, a tidy one by Fazalhaq Farooqi.
Fuller, angled down leg. Shakib Al Hasan hangs back and clips it to deep square leg for a single.
A length ball, angled into the pads. Shakib Al Hasan stays inside the crease and defends it to the leg side.
FOUR! Shakib Al Hasan lost some control over his shot but manages to clear the infield. A full-length ball, wide outside off. Shakib Al Hasan reaches out and lofts it over extra cover for a boundary.
Touch fuller and close to the off pole. Shakib Al Hasan drives it to covers. But does not beat the man yet again.
A length ball, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan punches it to cover. Not in the gap though.
Full and on off, blocked out watchfully.

BEATEN! A carrom ball, around off, Mahmudullah presses forward and looks to defend it out. He misses and the ball flies past the outside edge. It also wasn't far away from the off pole. Mujeeb Ur Rahman doing really well to keep things tight.
Quicker, flatter and on the stumps. Mahmudullah blocks it back to the bowler.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Shakib Al Hasan leans forward and flicks it to mid on for a single.
Floated, around off. Shakib Al Hasan punches it to the off side.
Flatter and short, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan stays back and cuts it through point. They collect a brace.
Mahmudullah comes in at number 6.

OUT! STUMPS SHATTERED! This is sensational from Fazalhaq Farooqi. He is getting the ball to talk both ways and has the speed to breach the defense as well. Hurls it across on a length around middle, at 136.4 kph, it lands and skids through as Yasir Ali is late in bringing his bat down. The ball sneaks through and demolishes the stumps. Fazalhaq Farooqi jumps in joy, he has picked four wickets in his three overs. Dream stuff, a double-wicket maiden!
Nearly drags it on! Fazalhaq Farooqi feeds it on a length close to off, Yasir Ali looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
On a length around off, Yasir defends it from the back foot.
Another delivery outside off, Ali allows it through.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Debutant Yasir Ali comes in to bat now.

Review! The onfield decision is out and Mushfiqur Rahim takes a review for lbw. The UltraEdge shows no bat is involved. The Ball Tracking shows three reds. Mushfiqur Rahim has to walk back for a low score.

OUT! LBW! Mushfiqur Rahim is gone. Fazalhaq Farooqi is on fire. Brilliant stuff from the left-arm seamer. He is getting the ball to bend back in. Lands it around off and it moves back in to beat the forward defensive prod of Mushfiqur Rahim. He is rapped on the pads and the finger has gone up. Rahim though has taken the referral.  It's pad first, confirms the UltraEdge as the bat is a little away. The Ball Tracking finds everything adjacent - three reds and Rahim is sent packing as well. Seems they all prepared for Rashid Khan and Fazalhaq Farooqi has come out of the syllabus.
Full again, around off, pushed to covers to end the over.
Slider around off, skidding in from a fuller length, Shakib gets an inside edge onto the pads as he attempts to defend.
Fuller and on off, Rahim knocks it down to long on for a single.
Floated and around middle, Rahim goes on the back foot and blocks it on the leg side.
A touch flatter through the air, fuller in length, Shakib drives it past the diving cover fielder for a single.
Flighted and full around off, Rahim leans across and flicks it through square leg for a single.
Delivers it on a length around leg, Rahim ticks it away towards square leg for a single.
Mushfiqur Rahim comes in at number 4 and he comes out pretty early. Can the experienced pair of Shakib Al Hasan and Mushfiqur Rahim take Bangladesh to safer shores?

OUT! LBW! A body blow to Bangladesh as their skipper returns and what an over from Fazalhaq Farooqi - has removed both the openers in a matter of three balls. Great delivery from Fazalhaq Farooqi, he serves it on a length outside off and gets it to nip back in sharply. Tamim is forward a shade in defense but it beats his bat and pings him on the front pad. The appeal is not entertained. It's a big wicket so Hashmatullah Shahidi is ready to take his chance with the referral. UltraEdge finds no bat and the Ball Tracking brings a lot of joy in the Afghan camp. Three reds and Tamim returns dejected. The crowd has gone silent.
LEG BYE! A length ball, angled down leg. Shakib Al Hasan gets a pad on it, as it rolled towards fine leg. They collected a leg bye.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Fantastic delivery and Afghanistan have got an early breakthrough. Zippy delivery, on a length around off and skidding off the surface, Das tries to block from the back foot but it whizzes past the inside edge. Rahmanullah Gurbaz collects the ball with a dive and is charging forward in appeal but the finger stays down. The keeper has convinced his skipper to take the DRS. UltraEdge detects a spike and Fazalhaq Farooqi draws first blood.
Commentary.Howout: c Rahmanullah Gurbaz b Fazalhaq Farooqi

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length around off, Liton is on the back foot again as he blocks it to the off side.
Shakib Al Hasan is the new man in.
On a length, around leg, Das stays on the back foot and defends it on the leg side.
Full and around off, Tamim is forward as he drives it to short cover.
Shortish and outside off, played down late, to the left of backward point, for a single.
Fuller and around off, Das pushes it off his front foot to covers.
Beaten! Quicker one outside off, holding its line, Liton Das goes back and plays for the spin but is beaten.
Leans forward to a full ball and defends it to the off side.
Flatter off spinner around off, Liton goes on the back foot and punches it to mid-wicket.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman to bowl spin from the other end.

FOUR! Shot! This time good power on this shot. Drifting down the leg side, Tamim Iqbal shuffles across the stumps and whips it through square leg for a boundary. 12 from the first over, a great start for the home team.
FOUR! Great timing! Just a mere push and it has gone to the fence. A length ball on middle and leg, Tamim Iqbal gets across and flicks it through mid-wicket. The ball races away crosses the rope.

Four leg byes! Bangladesh are away in this chase. Fazalhaq Farooqi misses his radar and slips a length ball down the leg side. Tamim fails to flick but it takes his pads and scoots away to the fine leg fence.
Back of a length, around off, hurrying up the batter slightly, Tamim Iqbal tries to play on the leg side but it takes a soft leading edge and rolls towards covers.
Short in length and outside off, Tamim Iqbal allows it through to the keeper. The balls moves a little more on its way to the keeper.
Nice shot but for no run. Full and around off, some movement for the bowler, Tamim Iqbal plays a flowing drive but finds the short cover fielder.
